fill(bytes32,bytes,bytes).details: Takes the output from the filler, pays the user, and — this being one chain — releases the      escrowed input to the filler in the same call. `filled` is set before either transfer.

open((uint32,bytes32,bytes)).details: The self-signed path: the user is `msg.sender`, so a plain `transferFrom` replaces Permit2.

openFor((address,address,uint256,uint256.details: The user signed offchain; anyone may submit. Permit2 both verifies that signature and moves      the input into escrow.

fill(bytes32,bytes,bytes).notice: Fills a single leg of an order on the destination chain.

orderIdFor((address,address,uint256,uint.notice: The order id for a gasless order — the envelope's EIP-712 struct hash. Named after the         standard's own `resolveFor`; an integrator needs it to look the order up in `escrows`.
